description: Last Epoch monster damage reduction by monster level (enemy DR). Multiplier applied to all damage dealt to monsters: damage_taken = damage_model * (1 - dr).

source.title: Tunklab: Monster Damage Reduction
source.extraction: page module 713995 maps level e=1..100 to n.k[e], where module 673465 exports k=[...] (101 values, index 0..100). The page renders mitigation = k[e]*100 percent.

notes: Levels 1-6 have 0% enemy damage reduction; level 7+ ramps up to 87% at level 100.
The source table covers monster levels 1-100 only.
Integration treats monster DR as a separate multiplicative target-side factor applied after resistance/penetration: final = model_damage * (1 - effective_resistance) * (1 - monster_dr).
Level 0 in the calculator means 'disabled / no monster DR' for comparing to the previous no-DR runs.
